segments.mil7.2.10:1.1: “Bhante nāgasena,‘makkaṭassa dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī’ti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve aṅgāni gahetabbānī”ti?
segments.mil7.2.10:1.2: “Yathā, mahārāja, makkaṭo vāsamupagacchanto tathārūpe okāse mahatimahārukkhe pavivitte sabbaṭṭhakasākhe [sabbatthakasākhe (syā.), sabbaṭṭhasākhe (ka.)] bhīruttāṇe vāsamupagacchati, evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena lajjiṃ pesalaṃ sīlavantaṃ kalyāṇadhammaṃ bahussutaṃ dhammadharaṃ vinayadharaṃ piyaṃ garubhāvanīyaṃ vattāraṃ vacanakkhamaṃ ovādakaṃ viññāpakaṃ sandassakaṃ samādapakaṃ samuttejakaṃ sampahaṃsakaṃ evarūpaṃ kalyāṇamittaṃ ācariyaṃ nissāya viharitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.10:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, makkaṭassa paṭhamaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.10:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, mahārāja, makkaṭo rukkhe yeva carati tiṭṭhati nisīdati, yadi niddaṃ okkamati, tattheva rattiṃ vāsamanubhavati.
segments.mil7.2.10:2.2: Evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena pavanābhimukhena bhavitabbaṃ, pavane yeva ṭhānacaṅkamanisajjāsayanaṃ niddaṃ okkamitabbaṃ, tattheva satipaṭṭhānamanubhavitabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.10:2.3: Idaṃ, mahārāja, makkaṭassa dutiyaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
segments.mil7.2.10:7.1: Gadrabho ceva [ghorassaro ca (sī. syā. pī.)] kukkuṭo, kalando dīpini dīpiko;
segments.mil7.2.10:7.3: Kummo vaṃso ca cāpo ca, vāyaso atha makkaṭoti.
